name: File Processing & Object Storage
description: File Processing & Object Storage standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-BE-FILE applies.

rules.title: Treat uploaded files as untrusted input
rules.detail: Validate size, extension and detected content type; reject unexpected formats and normalize generated filenames/paths.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Treat uploaded files as untrusted input.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Treat uploaded files as untrusted input.

rules.title: Store objects outside the web root by default
rules.detail: Serve private files through authorized application or signed URLs rather than predictable public filesystem paths.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Store objects outside the web root by default.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Store objects outside the web root by default.

rules.title: Prevent path traversal and object-key injection
rules.detail: Generate server-controlled storage keys and never concatenate untrusted path segments into local/object-storage paths.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Prevent path traversal and object-key injection.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Prevent path traversal and object-key injection.

rules.title: Scan or quarantine risky file types when threat model requires it
rules.detail: Malware scanning and safe preview/transcoding should occur before broad distribution of untrusted files.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Scan or quarantine risky file types when threat model requires it.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Scan or quarantine risky file types when threat model requires it.

rules.title: Stream large files and bound memory use
rules.detail: Use streaming/multipart mechanisms and explicit size/time limits rather than loading arbitrary files fully into process memory.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Stream large files and bound memory use.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Stream large files and bound memory use.

rules.title: Define lifecycle and orphan cleanup
rules.detail: File metadata, business ownership, retention and deletion remain consistent when uploads fail or parent records are removed.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define lifecycle and orphan cleanup.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define lifecycle and orphan cleanup.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-BE-FILE applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of File Processing & Object Storage to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: File Processing & Object Storage is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses File Processing & Object Storage failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
